clips.title: The story
paras: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Azar Stronghammer guides new dwarven paladins. After completing his own training in the Holy Light, he sends promising recruits to Ironforge for further instruction.

Azar Stronghammer guides new dwarven paladins at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Humans are often linked to the great cathedrals, yet the dwarves of Khaz Modan have embraced the virtues of the Holy Light. Azar has mastered his own martial and spiritual vows, and helps newly inducted paladins find their footing on Dun Morogh's freezing slopes. When a novice shows dedication and spiritual maturity, he sends them up the mountain path to Ironforge. There they can study under veteran champions such as Tiza Battleforge.
